title: SmPC headings
text: The SmPC uses the headings of the WHOPAR Part 4 template, sections 1 to 10 in order.

title: Required content is filled
text: Each heading of the SmPC has content.

title: Scope statement
text: The SmPC opens by saying it covers the uses prequalified by WHO and that national authorities may authorise other uses.

title: WHO reference number
text: Section 8 gives the WHO reference number of the prequalified product (for example "MA999(a)").

title: Dates
text: Section 9 gives the date of prequalification and section 10 the month and year of the last revision, not earlier than prequalification.

title: Frequency terms in 4.8
text: Undesirable effects use the MedDRA frequency convention (very common, common, uncommon, rare, very rare, not known), not words such as "often" or "sometimes".
